rationale: The Evaluator feedback indicates that the last candidate has not yet been raced, so we lack telemetry to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The feedback suggests reducing base_speed slightly to 1.4 to improve stability and reduce aggressive driving, increasing kd to 3.5 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations, and adjusting sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0] to increase the influence of the inner sensors for better steering precision while maintaining balance. I have implemented these changes accordingly, keeping kp at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain responsiveness and integral correction. The geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. I expect these changes to improve stability, reduce line loss events, and maintain good speed. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects.
